prompt: gperf --pic struct-type first field type requirement
answer: With `--pic` (`-P` or `%pic`) and `--struct-type` (`-t`), the first field of the user-defined struct must be of type `int`, not `char *`. It stores an offset into the string pool. The field must be named `name` by default, or whatever name is specified with `-K` / `%define slot-name`.
